# PHASE0_FOUNDER_OVERRIDE_DECISION.md

## 0. Decision Summary

Phase 0 external evaluation package was prepared, but external evaluation has not been executed yet.

The project will proceed to Phase 1 sales MVP preparation via Founder Override.

This is not a claim that external evaluation was completed.

---

## 1. External Evaluation Status

Status:

- Not executed

Evaluator count:

- 0

Median scores:

- Not available

Reason:

- The founder decided to proceed to a sales MVP preparation phase without fabricating external evaluation results.
- Real market demand will be tested through a semi-manual paid validation MVP.

---

## 2. Founder Override Decision

Decision:

- Proceed to Phase 1 sales MVP preparation

Rationale:

- G001/G002/G003 golden samples have been approved internally.
- The current priority is to test whether users will actually pay for the service.
- A lightweight sales MVP can validate willingness to pay faster than building a full app.
- The project will not claim external validation until real evaluator or customer responses are collected.

---

## 3. Risks

Known risks:

- No external target-user feedback has been collected yet.
- Pricing acceptance is unknown.
- The copy may still be too long, too soft, too suspicious, or too similar to ChatGPT.
- The conversion rate from LP to paid order is unknown.
- Payment provider acceptance for AI/fortune-telling style services is not yet confirmed.

---

## 4. Mitigation

Mitigation plan:

- Build only a minimal sales MVP.
- Do not build full app functionality yet.
- Use manual delivery to control quality.
- Track LP views, form starts, form submissions, paid orders, refunds, satisfaction, repeat intent, and “ChatGPT is enough” feedback.
- Decide Go / Iterate / No-Go based on actual sales validation results.

---

## 5. Integrity Rule

Do not fabricate:

- evaluator count
- evaluator comments
- score medians
- purchase count
- user testimonials
- paid conversion data

All future validation results must be based on real responses or real transactions.
